title: Streaming service
description: A streaming platform grouped by the team that owns each part. Pick a request and step through it.

frames.label: Overview
frames.caption: Four teams own the platform; client apps sit outside it.

frames.label: Press play
frames.caption: The viewer presses play on episode 4 in the TV app.

frames.label: Request
frames.caption: The TV app asks the gateway for something to play.

frames.label: Fan out
frames.caption: The gateway asks Playback for a manifest and Catalog for the title, at the same time.

frames.label: Licence
frames.caption: Playback needs a DRM licence before it hands out a manifest.

frames.label: Plan
frames.caption: DRM checks the viewer's plan with Accounts.

frames.label: Licensed
frames.caption: The plan is Premium, so DRM issues a licence.

frames.label: Fan in
frames.caption: Playback's manifest and Catalog's title both come back to the gateway.

frames.label: Start
frames.caption: The gateway answers the TV app, which starts the stream.

frames.label: Search
frames.caption: The viewer searches for “drama” on the web.

frames.label: Request
frames.caption: The web app sends the search through the gateway.

frames.label: Route
frames.caption: The gateway routes it to Catalog.

frames.label: History
frames.caption: Search reads the viewer's recent history to rank results.

frames.label: Rank
frames.caption: Sessions answers, and Search returns ranked hits.

frames.label: Results
frames.caption: Catalog's titles go back through the gateway to the web app.

frames.label: Transcode
frames.caption: A new episode is transcoded into 720p, 1080p and 4K renditions, stored as segments.

frames.label: Announce
frames.caption: Once the segments are stored, Encoding announces the title on Events.

gateway-title.title: Gateway asks Catalog for the title

playback-licence.title: Playback asks DRM for a licence
